shortDescription: Manage protection group snapshots on Everpure FlashArrays

options.name: add_to_pgs
options.description: A volume created from a snapshot will be added to the specified protection groups

options.name: api_token
options.description: FlashArray API token for admin privileged user.

options.name: apply_retention
options.description: Apply retention schedule settings to the snapshot

options.name: client_id
options.description: ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: context
options.description: Name of fleet member on which to perform the operation. This requires the array receiving the request is a member of a fleet and the context name to be a member of the same fleet.

options.name: disable_warnings
options.description: Disable insecure certificate warnings in debug logs

options.name: eradicate
options.description: Define whether to eradicate the snapshot on delete or leave in trash.

options.name: fa_url
options.description: FlashArray management IPv4 address or Hostname.

options.name: id_token
options.description: A pre-signed JWT to authenticate with, as an alternative to I(api_token). The token is exchanged by the array for a short-lived access token. Requires a matching API Client to be registered on the array (see M(everpure.flasharray.purefa_apiclient)).

options.name: issuer
options.description: The API Client's trusted identity issuer registered on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: key_id
options.description: Key ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the source protection group.

options.name: now
options.description: Whether to initiate a snapshot of the protection group immediately

options.name: offload
options.description: Name of offload target on which the snapshot exists. This is only applicable for deletion and erasure of snapshots

options.name: overwrite
options.description: Define whether to overwrite the target volume if it already exists. Required when I(restore=all) and restoring to an existing protection group.

options.name: private_key_file
options.description: Path to the PEM RSA private key used to sign an identity token, as an alternative to I(api_token). Requires I(client_id), I(key_id), I(issuer) and I(username).

options.name: private_key_password
options.description: Password protecting I(private_key_file), if encrypted.

options.name: remote
options.description: Force immediate snapshot to remote targets

options.name: restore
options.description: Restore a specific volume from a protection group snapshot, or use C(all) to restore all member volumes at once. The protection group name is not required. Only provide the name of the volume to be restored, or C(all) to restore all volumes. When using C(all), if restoring to an existing protection group the I(overwrite) parameter must be set to C(true). When using C(all), the I(target) parameter can specify a new or existing protection group name. If not specified, it defaults to the source pro

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the protection group snapshot should exist or not. Copy (added in 2.7) will create a full read/write clone of the snapshot.

options.name: suffix
options.description: Suffix of snapshot name. Special case. If I(latest) the module will select the latest snapshot created in the group

options.name: target
options.description: Volume to restore a specified volume to. If not supplied this will default to the volume defined in I(restore) Name of new snapshot suffix if renaming a snapshot When I(restore=all), this specifies the target protection group name. If not supplied, defaults to the source protection group name.

options.name: throttle
options.description: If set to true, allows snapshot to fail if array health is not optimal.

options.name: username
options.description: Username the issued token should be granted to. Must be a valid user on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: with_default_protection
options.description: Whether to add the default container protection groups to those specified in I(add_to_pgs) as the initial protection of a volume created from a snapshot.
